description: Ministry of Land  &  Parliament Reforms - Appoint Land Acquiring Officers for Gampaha District and cancelled the appointment of Additional Acquiring Officers
reasoning: This gazette primarily concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically appoints and cancels appointments of Acquiring Officers for land acquisitions related to the Central Expressway Project in the Gampaha District. The content focuses on property/land administrative procedures and officer appointments for land acquisition purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions government officials, the core subject matter is land acquisition rather than government structure or personnel changes.
